summary: HF Foods Group filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 disclosing termination of its Sales Agreement with D.A. Davidson and Roth Capital Partners, effective September 24, 2026, thereby shutting down the at-the-market equity program established September 25, 2025 and suspending the related prospectus supplement. No shares, price, premium, or consideration were disclosed. CFO Paul McGarry signed the report; a press release (Exhibit 99.1) announced the action. The move removes a potential equity overhang rather than representing a transaction; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for alternative financing needs or capital structure signals.
